title: 初三四材料：陶器与铁路旧物
source_notice: 初三公开普通期末转载完整题面/印本脚本/参考键已核，原音轨明确缺；地域学年学期只在标题，正文只见九年级英语，原校认证未建立，不当gold。本稿完整原创配套不补平原录音缺口。
timing_notice: 每段两遍；原卷未印精确停顿，本机听前后每题5秒及重播提示属审阅编排
instruction: 听四段材料，依次回答1—2、3—4、5—7、8—10题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。第三段为独白，其他为对话。每段两遍；本机按每题前后5秒留时，不冒充原卷未印时序。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Are you still going to the pottery workshop on Sunday, Dan?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. Last time I made a bowl, but this time I want to make a small jug.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Do we need to bring clay?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No, the teacher provides it. Bring an old shirt, though. Your sleeves may get dirty.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Good idea. I will put one in my bag tonight.

questions.stem: What does Dan want to make?
questions.rationale: A：未做盘子；B：是上次作品；C：明确本次小水壶
A：老师提供黏土；B：明确建议旧衬衫；C：未提新颜料

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You look tired, Rosa. Have you been studying late?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: No. Our neighbour's dog barks early every morning and wakes me up.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Have you told the neighbour?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I do not want to sound unfriendly.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You can explain it politely. They may not know how much noise the dog makes.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: You are right. I will speak to them this afternoon.

questions.rationale: A：明确狗叫吵醒；B：女方否认熬夜学习；C：未跑步
A：没有买狗；B：没有搬家；C：接受建议下午沟通

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: This Saturday, the railway history room will display objects from the old North Line station. The station closed forty years ago. Most of the objects were found in its store room last winter. You can see lamps, tickets and a large station clock. A former railway worker will explain how the clock was set before every morning's first train. The display opens at ten, but the talk begins at eleven. Entry is free. Children can stamp a paper ticket to take home, but the metal signs must stay behind the ropes.

questions.stem: Where were most of the objects found?
questions.rationale: A：未说花园；B：明确旧站储藏室；C：未在列车找到

questions.stem: When will the worker's talk begin?
questions.rationale: A：是开门时间；B：无10:30；C：明确十一点讲解
A：明确可盖纸票带走；B：标牌留在绳后；C：灯为展品

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: You have invited your exchange partner to dinner, haven't you, Owen?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes, but I am worried about choosing the food. I do not know what she can eat.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Ask her directly. She will probably appreciate that.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will send her a message. I thought of making fish, but perhaps there is something she avoids.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Also, let her know dinner is at six. Our family usually eats earlier than she does.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Should I plan games for afterwards?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: One simple game would be nice, but give her time to talk. She may want to ask about your family.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Thanks. I was planning too much. A relaxed evening sounds better.

questions.rationale: A：时间已定；B：明确不知道对方能吃什么；C：未谈花园

questions.stem: What will Owen do first about the food?
questions.rationale: A：只是原设想；B：未咨询老师；C：明确发消息问客人

questions.stem: What does the girl suggest for after dinner?
options: Plan games for the whole evening.
questions.rationale: A：建议简单游戏并留聊天时间；B：反对安排过满；C：没有催客人走
